description: Given an actual native intuitionistic \(T\)-certificate of \(A\), with finite support \(\Gamma\subseteq T\), and supplied \(S\)-certificates of \(F_R(C)\) for every \(C\in T\), the specified operation selects image preimages only from \(\Gamma\) and replaces the finite image proof using those supplied certificates. It constructs an actual \(S\)-certificate of \(F_R(A)\) with the same equality mode.
